changelog:
- Initial release of the skill "tailor-cover-letter."
- Edits Google Docs cover letters to match a specific job role, ensuring consistency with the accompanying resume.
- Requires three inputs: editable cover letter doc link, resume, and role description.
- Directly corrects grammar, spelling, structure, and clarity without altering factual claims; substantive changes are suggested and require user approval before insertion.
- Ensures all claims in the cover letter are strictly supported by the resume or user confirmation—never invents or inflates experience.
- Summarizes copyedits made, highlights role priorities covered, and lists pending user-approved suggestions after editing.
summary: Tailor and polish an existing cover letter in Google Docs for a specific role while keeping every claim consistent with the resume that will accompany it. Use when the user provides an editable GDoc cover-letter link, the associated resume, and a role description.
